text:
samir: opened PR to roll back the kv-proxy change that correlated with the p99 spike, can someone take a look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8592 :eyes:

alex: on it, will review in ~15m

maria: @alex fyi canary in us-west-2 showed increased gRPC 503s at 09:12, I'm watching SLOs

deploy-bot: Canary run failed for commit 3f1a7b1 — test shard 2 timed out

jin: adding logs for the failing shard:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z kv-proxy | error: upstream timeout after 250ms
2026-03-16T09:12:04Z kv-proxy | retry 1
```

alex: quick skim — looks like connection pool backoff regression, left inline comment on the PR re: backoff default

samir: thanks @alex, I pushed a tiny revert to the config in the PR branch. hoping to merge once we have 1 more approval.

maria: i'll stand by for post-merge watch, can you add a short rollback step in the PR description? helps oncall later :+1:

alex: left LGTM after the revert, no prob on description

oncall-bot: scheduled post-merge health-checks (5m, 15m, 1h) for service=kv-proxy

samir: merging in 3m unless anyone objects

jin: no objections from infra, go ahead

samir: merged. monitoring now, will reopen if p99 stays high.

maria: seeing p99 drop back under target in the canary, looks good so far :thumbsup:

alex: nice, great triage team. I'll follow up with a short blameless postmortem note in #postmortems later.

samir: thanks all.
